extDescription.message: Save pictures from any web page into SD Image Sorter on this computer, with the page they came from.

badgeUnpaired.message: not paired yet - open the options to pair

badgePending.message: waiting for Allow in the program

errorOffline.message: SD Image Sorter is not running, or not at the address set in the extension options.

errorNotPaired.message: This browser is not paired with SD Image Sorter. Open the extension options and press Pair.

errorReadFailed.message: This picture could not be read from the page.

errorExtensionReloaded.message: The extension was updated or reloaded. Reload this page and try again.

savedMany.message: Saved $1 pictures to SD Image Sorter.

savedSomeFailed.message: Saved $1 pictures; $2 not saved. First reason: $3

dropHere.message: Drop here to save to SD Image Sorter

dropHint.message: Saved with the page it came from

pickerEmpty.message: No pictures found on this page.

optionsLead.message: Save pictures from any web page into SD Image Sorter on this computer, with the page they came from.

addressNote.message: Only an address on this computer (127.0.0.1 or localhost) is accepted. The default is http://127.0.0.1:8487.

addressInvalid.message: Write an address on this computer, for example http://127.0.0.1:8487.

pairLead.message: The program asks "Allow this browser extension?" in its own window. Nothing can be saved until you allow it there.

permissionLead.message: The browser has not given this extension access to web pages, so it cannot read pictures or reach the program.

dropBoxLabel.message: Show a drop box while I drag a picture

saveLead.message: Right-click a picture and choose "Save to SD Image Sorter", or "Save pictures on this page..." to pick several. Pictures go to the program's output folder under collected/<date> and appear in its gallery.

statusOffline.message: SD Image Sorter is not running at $1. Start it, then press Test connection.

statusUnpaired.message: Connected to SD Image Sorter $1 at $2. Not paired yet: press Pair with the program.

statusPending.message: Waiting for you to press Allow in SD Image Sorter...

statusDenied.message: SD Image Sorter said no to this pairing. Press Pair to ask again.

statusPaired.message: Connected and paired with SD Image Sorter $1 at $2.

statusPairExpired.message: The pairing request was not answered in time or the program restarted. Press Pair to ask again.

statusForgotten.message: This browser forgot the pairing. To remove it from the program too, use Settings > Browser extension > Revoke.

popupUnpaired.message: The program is running, but this browser is not paired yet.

popupPaired.message: Connected. Right-click any picture to save it.
